title: Internet banking: container view
description: C4 container view of the Internet Banking System. A personal banking customer uses a single-page app or a mobile app to view balances and make payments. Both call one API application, which reads and writes its own PostgreSQL database, gets account data from the existing mainframe banking system over XML/HTTPS, and sends e-mail to the customer through the bank's e-mail system. The mainframe and the e-mail system are outside the system boundary.

nodes.label: Personal Banking Customer
nodes.desc: A customer of the bank with personal accounts.

nodes.label: Single-Page App

nodes.label: Mobile App
nodes.desc: A limited set of banking functions on a phone.

nodes.label: API Application
nodes.desc: Provides banking functions through a JSON/HTTPS API.
